name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  CI_NODE_VERSION: '26.10.0'

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.CI_NODE_VERSION }}
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Install actionlint
        env:
          ACTIONLINT_LINUX_AMD64_SHA256: 8aca8db96f1b94770f1b0d72b6dddcb1ebb8123cb3712530b08cc387b349a3d8
          ACTIONLINT_VERSION: 1.7.12
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          archive="actionlint_${ACTIONLINT_VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
          curl -fsSLO "https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/download/v${ACTIONLINT_VERSION}/${archive}"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$ACTIONLINT_LINUX_AMD64_SHA256" "$archive" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf "$archive" actionlint
          sudo install -m 0755 actionlint /usr/local/bin/actionlint
      - name: Validate workflows
        run: scripts/validate-workflows.sh

  action-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Read release tool defaults
        id: defaults
        run: |
          ruby -rpsych -e '
            workflow = Psych.safe_load(File.read(".github/workflows/release-electron.yml"))
            # Psych reads the unquoted YAML 1.1 key on as true.
            inputs = workflow.fetch(true).fetch("workflow_call").fetch("inputs")
            %w[node-version pnpm-version goreleaser-version].each do |name|
              puts "#{name}=#{inputs.fetch(name).fetch("default")}"
            end
          ' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version: '1.27.2'
          cache: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
        with:
          version: ${{ steps.defaults.outputs.pnpm-version }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ steps.defaults.outputs.node-version }}
          package-manager-cache: false
      - uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@a4f02ab5355a589de60d917a659ce617ed19b3de # v7.3.0
        with:
          version: ${{ steps.defaults.outputs.goreleaser-version }}
          install-only: true
      - name: Build and run an unsigned snapshot
        run: scripts/smoke-release-build.sh
      - name: Build and run with the default Swift Linux image
        run: bash scripts/smoke-swift-toolchain.sh
      - name: Upload named payload
        id: input-upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: action-integration-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: README.md
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1
      - name: Download named payload
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ steps.input-upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/generated-input
          digest-mismatch: error
      - name: Build generated asset using the production source step
        env:
          GENERATED_ASSET: fixture-source.txt
          GENERATED_INPUT_ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ steps.input-upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
          TEST_COMMAND: cp "$RELEASE_ASSET_INPUT_DIR/README.md" "$RELEASE_ASSET_PATH"
        run: |
          node <<'JS'
          const {execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');
          const {loadWorkflow,workflowStep}=require('./scripts/workflow-source.cjs');
          const step=workflowStep(loadWorkflow('release-source.yml'),'build','name','Run caller tests without write credentials');
          execFileSync('/bin/bash',['-c',step.run],{env:process.env,stdio:'inherit'});
          JS
      - name: Upload generated raw payload
        id: generated-upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: generated-integration-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/raw
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1
      - name: Download generated raw payload
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ steps.generated-upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/generated-raw
          digest-mismatch: error
      - name: Verify bytes and GitHub client
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        with:
          script: |
            const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
            const fs = require('node:fs');
            const path = require('node:path');
            assert.deepEqual(
              fs.readFileSync(path.join(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP, 'generated-input', 'README.md')),
              fs.readFileSync('README.md'),
            );
            const {execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');
            const {loadWorkflow,workflowStep}=require('./scripts/workflow-source.cjs');
            const workflow=loadWorkflow('release-source.yml');
            const payload=path.join(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP,'payload');
            fs.mkdirSync(payload);
            fs.writeFileSync(path.join(payload,'RELEASE-NOTES.md'),'Integration fixture notes.\n');
            const env={...process.env,PAYLOAD:payload,GENERATED_ASSET:'fixture-source.txt',SOURCE_ARCHIVES:'false',RELEASE_VERSION:'1.2.3',TAG:'integration',TARGET_SHA:process.env.GITHUB_SHA};
            for(const [job,name] of [['assemble','Accept only the requested generated asset'],['assemble','Freeze inventory and checksums'],['verify','Independently verify frozen bytes'],['verify-arm','Independently verify frozen bytes']]) {
              execFileSync('/bin/bash',['-c',workflowStep(workflow,job,'name',name).run],{env,stdio:'inherit'});
            }
            assert.deepEqual(fs.readFileSync(path.join(payload,'fixture-source.txt')),fs.readFileSync('README.md'));
            const { data } = await github.rest.repos.get(context.repo);
            assert.equal(data.full_name, process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY);
            core.info('same-run input/output artifact bytes, production source verifiers and github-script REST client passed');

  swift-keychain-lifecycle:
    runs-on: xcode-27

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:

      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:

        run: node scripts/test-sparkle-tools.mjs

  macos-architecture:
    runs-on: xcode-27
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        arch: [arm64, x86_64]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Prove native and Rosetta execution with an explicit deployment target

          EXPECTED_ARCH: ${{ matrix.arch }}
          MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: '14.0'
        run: bash scripts/smoke-macos-runner.sh

        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0

# Clawdex Homebrew handoff regression

The two JSON files are the unmodified independent verifier attestations from
[clawdex release run 34176514772](https://github.com/openclaw/clawdex/actions/runs/34176514772),
artifacts `verified-inventory-{arm64,x86_64}-release-verification-payload-34176514772-1`.
They differ only in `architecture`. Their inventory and `checksums.txt` match
the published [v0.2.2 assets](https://github.com/openclaw/clawdex/releases/tag/v0.2.2).

`clawdex.rb` is the formula written by the successful
[tap run 34176797544](https://github.com/openclaw/homebrew-tap/actions/runs/34176797544),
at commit `23b68b2a5ae7b83957f18c786b92ec15a3ec8260`.
The handoff rejected its literal `skip_clean "bin/clawdex"` metadata. The
`digest-mismatch: error` lines were download-action configuration, not failures.

The local suite executes the production validators against these frozen inputs.
The Homebrew preflight CI additionally fetches that exact formula and all
published release assets, binds their bytes to both attestations, and executes
the same validators without dispatching a tap update or evaluating formula code.

name: Release workflows
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: SemVer to release
        required: true
        type: string
      dry_run:
        description: Validate without creating a tag or release
        default: true
        type: boolean
permissions: {}
jobs:
  release:
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: write
      statuses: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/release-source.yml
    with:
      version: ${{ inputs.version }}
      dry_run: ${{ inputs.dry_run }}
      test-command: bash -n scripts/validate-workflows.sh
      source-archives: true
      require-signed-tag: true

name: Crabbox Release Check

on:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  release-check:
    name: Release Check
    if: github.repository == 'openclaw/crabbox'
    runs-on: xcode-27
    timeout-minutes: 45

    steps:
      - name: Check out target merge commit
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify target identity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" = openclaw/crabbox
          test "$GITHUB_BASE_REF" = main
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"

      - name: Verify Apple Silicon runner
        run: test "$(uname -m)" = arm64

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: false

      - name: Snapshot release build
        uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@a4f02ab5355a589de60d917a659ce617ed19b3de # v7.3.0
        with:
          distribution: goreleaser
          version: "~> v2"
          args: release --snapshot --clean --skip=publish --parallelism 1

      - name: Verify snapshot helper embeds VM daemon
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          helper="$(find dist -type f -name crabbox-apple-vm-helper -print -quit)"
          if [ -z "$helper" ] || [ ! -x "$helper" ]; then
            echo "::error::snapshot Apple VM helper not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! "$helper" vmd-info | grep -q '"embedded":true'; then
            echo "::error::snapshot Apple VM helper is missing the embedded VM daemon"
            exit 1
          fi

name: Dry run archetypes
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: Version matching the dated changelog and synthetic package fixture
        type: string
        required: true
        default: 1.11.0
permissions: {}
jobs:
  npm-package:
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: write
      statuses: read
      id-token: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/release-npm-package.yml
    with:
      version: ${{ inputs.version }}
      dry_run: true
      package-dirs: '["scripts/fixtures/npm-monorepo/packages/core","scripts/fixtures/npm-monorepo/packages/cli"]'
      install-command: ':'
      build-command: ':'
      smoke-command: node -e "require('node:assert/strict').equal(require('@release-fixture/cli').version, '1.11.0')"
  source:
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: write
      statuses: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/release-source.yml
    with:
      version: ${{ inputs.version }}
      dry_run: true
      source-archives: true
      generated-asset: source-fixture.tar.gz
      test-command: |
        bash -n scripts/validate-workflows.sh
        tar -czf "$RELEASE_ASSET_PATH" README.md

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)
WORKFLOW="$ROOT/.github/workflows/release-go-cli.yml"

extract_helpers() {
  ruby -rpsych -e '
    workflow = Psych.safe_load(
      File.read(ARGV.fetch(0)),
      permitted_classes: [],
      permitted_symbols: [],
      aliases: false
    )
    job = workflow.fetch("jobs").fetch(ARGV.fetch(1))
    step = job.fetch("steps").find do |candidate|
      candidate["run"]&.include?("# signature-assertion-helpers-begin")
    end
    abort "signature assertion helpers not found in #{ARGV.fetch(1)}" unless step
    blocks = step.fetch("run").scan(
      /# signature-assertion-helpers-begin\n(.*?)# signature-assertion-helpers-end/m
    )
    abort "expected one signature helper block in #{ARGV.fetch(1)}" unless blocks.length == 1
    print blocks.fetch(0).fetch(0)
  ' "$WORKFLOW" "$1"
}

sign_helpers=$(extract_helpers sign)
verify_helpers=$(extract_helpers verify)
[[ "$sign_helpers" == "$verify_helpers" ]] || {
  echo "sign and verify signature assertion helpers differ" >&2
  exit 1
}
eval "$sign_helpers"

identifier=org.openclaw.eightctl.eightctl
team_id=FWJYW4S8P8
authority="Developer ID Application: OpenClaw Foundation ($team_id)"
display=$(printf '%s\n' \
  'Executable=/tmp/eightctl' \
  "Identifier=$identifier" \
  "Authority=$authority" \
  'Authority=Developer ID Certification Authority' \
  'Authority=Apple Root CA' \
  "TeamIdentifier=$team_id" \
  'CodeDirectory v=20500 size=123 flags=0x10000(runtime) hashes=1+0 location=embedded' \
  'Timestamp=Jul 17, 2026 at 10:00:00 PM')

assert_signature_equal "identifier" "$identifier" "$(codesign_display_value Identifier "$display")" fixture
assert_signature_line_present "authority-name" "$authority" "$(codesign_display_values Authority "$display")" fixture
assert_signature_equal "team-id" "$team_id" "$(codesign_display_value TeamIdentifier "$display")" fixture
assert_signature_runtime "hardened-runtime" "$(awk '/^CodeDirectory / { print; exit }' <<<"$display")" fixture
assert_signature_timestamp "trusted-timestamp" "$(codesign_display_value Timestamp "$display")" fixture
echo "PASS labeled public signature metadata assertions"

expected_requirement="designated => identifier \"$identifier\" and anchor apple generic and certificate leaf[subject.OU] = \"$team_id\""
display_requirement="designated => identifier $identifier and anchor apple generic and certificate leaf[subject.OU] = $team_id"
normalized_expected=$(normalize_designated_requirement "$expected_requirement")
for observed in \
  "$display_requirement" \
  "Executable=/tmp/eightctl"$'\n'"$display_requirement" \
  "$display_requirement"$'\n'"Executable=/tmp/eightctl" \
  "$display_requirement Executable=/tmp/eightctl"; do
  assert_signature_equal \
    "designated-requirement" \
    "$normalized_expected" \
    "$(normalize_designated_requirement "$observed")" \
    fixture
done
echo "PASS designated requirement quote and Executable header normalization"

if diagnostics=$(assert_signature_equal "team-id" "$team_id" WRONGTEAM fixture 2>&1); then
  echo "deliberate signature mismatch unexpectedly passed" >&2
  exit 1
fi
[[ "$diagnostics" == *'signature assertion failed [team-id] for fixture'* ]]
[[ "$diagnostics" == *"expected (public metadata): $team_id"* ]]
[[ "$diagnostics" == *'observed (public metadata): WRONGTEAM'* ]]
echo "PASS labeled mismatch diagnostics include sanitized observed and expected metadata"

bad_requirement=$(normalize_designated_requirement "${display_requirement/$team_id/WRONGTEAM}")
if diagnostics=$(assert_signature_equal \
  "designated-requirement" "$normalized_expected" "$bad_requirement" fixture 2>&1); then
  echo "deliberate designated requirement mismatch unexpectedly passed" >&2
  exit 1
fi
[[ "$diagnostics" == *'signature assertion failed [designated-requirement] for fixture'* ]]
[[ "$diagnostics" == *'certificate leaf[subject.OU] = WRONGTEAM'* ]]
echo "PASS designated requirement mismatch remains visible"
